mapper.select: select status as name, count(1) as value from property_detailed where authority='DEPOSITORY' and status in ('MAKE_USE_OF', 'LEAVE_UNUSED', 'WEED_OUT','REPAIR_REPORT') group by `status`
select receive_dep_id as name, count(1) as value from property_detailed where `status` = 'MAKE_USE_OF' group by receive_dep_id
select count(1) from property_weed_out a inner join property_weed_out_relation b on a.id = b.weed_out_id where a.manage_time between #{date.startTime} and #{date.endTime} and a.status = 'PASS'

select type_id as id,type_name as name, count(1) value from property_detailed where authority = 'DEPOSITORY' and status in ('MAKE_USE_OF', 'LEAVE_UNUSED', 'WEED_OUT') and type_name is NOT null
and type_name in
#{item}
GROUP BY type_name order by `value` desc
